from django.core import validators
from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError

    (validators.EmailValidator(message='"%(value)s" is not a valid email.'), 'blah'),
    (validators.RegexValidator(r'^[a-z]+$', message='"%(value)s" is not a match.'), 'BLAH'),
    (validators.URLValidator(message='"%(value)s" is not a valid URL.'), 'no-scheme'),
    (validators.MaxValueValidator(5, message='"%(value)s" exceeds %(limit_value)s.'), 10),
    (validators.DecimalValidator(2, 1), decimal.Decimal('123')),
    (validators.validate_ipv4_address, '999.1.1.1'),
    (validators.validate_slug, 'not ok!'),
    (validators.ProhibitNullCharactersValidator(), 'a\x00b'),
]

        print('NO ERROR (unexpected):', type(v).__name__, repr(val))

        print(f'{type(v).__name__}: {"; ".join(e.messages)}')
